# Test fixtures

These `.utl` files are real Virindi Tank Classic loot profiles used only as
round-trip test fixtures (to prove this project's parser reproduces VTank-authored
files byte-for-byte).

They come from **[lino-ranta/vtank-loot-profiles](https://github.com/lino-ranta/vtank-loot-profiles)**,
which is distributed under the **BSD 2-Clause License**. Copyright belongs to the
original author. They are redistributed here unmodified under that license for
testing purposes only.
